entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP.

2. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc. must be filed on or before 5-1-2024, failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. Put up this case on 15-04-2024.
4.

In the meantime, the order dated 7-6-2023 passed in Criminal Revision No. 217 of 2022 by learned Additional Sessions Judge-5th, East Champaran, Motihari, whereby the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.58575 of 2023(2) dt.18-12-2023 Criminal Revision Petition No. 217 of 2022 filed on behalf of the petitioners has been rejected, confirming the order of cognizance dated 9-3-2022 passed by learned SDJM, Sadar Motihari in Mahila PS Case No. 54 of 2020, whereby cognizance of offence has been taken under Sections 498A and 34 of the IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of the DP Smt. Mamta Shrivastava @ Mamta ... vs The State Of Bihar on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23073567/
1 Act, shall remain stayed.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text: DP Smt. Mamta Shrivastava @ Mamta ... vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits petitioners are mother-in-law and married sister-in-law of the OP No. 2.
It is next submitted that OP No. 2 is married to Saumitra Sinha, son of petitioner No. 1.
It is further submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife, the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) SUMIT/-
